| [Equipment integration — assessment and guidance](SKILL.md) | Agent Skill | Two entry routes to one protocol. Assessment — inventory a plant's or wave's machines, decide per machine which integration concept and connector applies, size and sequence the wave. Guidance — for one machine already assessed, route it to the IIoT Edge Platform or the Softing dataFEED Central OPC-UA Aggregation Server, walk the configuration pattern, clear the preparation gates, and take the right fallback when blocked. Use when a plant or wave starts, a machine's route is unclear, a use case is blocked for want of machine data, or someone asks how to connect a Siemens / Rockwell / Beckhoff / B&R / Omron / Mitsubishi / Modbus / OPC-UA device, configure a Softing dataFEED data source, or what to specify when ordering a new machine. |
